title: Document retired
description: The service tombstoned a document (#189): the doc is retired from every live surface (listing, per-doc routes, the UI emit bridge) but its version lineage stays on disk, write-once and auditable. Service-owned; requested over HTTP (DELETE /api/docs/:doc).

retired_at.description: The tombstone timestamp stamped into versions.json — the durable fact this event announces.

versions.description: How many versions the retired lineage holds (audit convenience).

project_id.description: ADDITIVE (DES-PROJECT-001 §2.3): the crew project this doc is bound to. Absent for unbound docs; consumers that don't know the field ignore it.
